description: Scanner parity fixtures. Both the Rust scanner (crates/anvil-checks/tests/scanner_parity.rs) and the TS scanner (packages/anvil/core/src/antipattern/scanner-parity.test.ts) load this file and assert that each fixture's expected warning set fires exactly. If both engines pass with the same fixture data, they are in parity. Post-SPG-003 every runnable registry rule has at least one positive and one negative fixture; opt-in rules set scan_options.include_opt_in: true.
